review_comment: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection'): The add function in MenquerySchema accepts user-defined handlers (parsers, formatters, validators) which are then applied via handler() and _refreshHandlersInParams(). This could permit execution of arbitrary code if malicious handlers are provided by users.
Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection'): The middleware function in menquery creates handlers that allow arbitrary code execution when user-defined plugins are included.
